_comment: Maps a logical PhraseKey (superapp-mobile/src/modules/jinni/services/jinniPhrases.ts) to one or more WAV files under superapp-mobile/assets/audio/jinni/hi-IN/<folder>/<file>. A phraseKey can list several files — audioPlayer picks one at random each time that phrase is spoken, so repeated phrases (e.g. 'thinking', heard on every wish) don't sound identical every time. This file is hand-edited — add/change a row here, then run `node scripts/generate-jinni-phrase-registry.js` from superapp-mobile/ to regenerate phraseRegistry.generated.ts. A row whose file does not actually exist on disk is safely skipped by the generator (logged, not crashed).
_mapping_note: Rewritten 2026-10-11 against the REAL files found in assets/audio/jinni/hi-IN/ (greeting/, search/, thinking/ only — no cart/errors/limits/listening folders exist yet). Matched by filename wording only, not by actually listening to the clips — please play each one and re-order/re-map in this file (then re-run the generator) if the content doesn't fit the slot.

entries._note: Both of these read as 'still searching' lines by their filenames, same as thinking/* — folded into the same phraseKey rather than guessed as 'found_items' confirmations, which they don't sound like. The generator merges every entry sharing a phraseKey into one pool.
